title: A small matrix library with const generics
description:
Write matrices whose sizes are checked by the compiler.

```
A (2x3) * B (3x2) = C (2x2)
A * A  -> does not compile: 2x3 times 2x3
identity::<3>() * v (3x1) = v
sum of all elements via iter().sum()
```
hints: The size of the product comes from the types: `Matrix<R, K> * Matrix<K, C>` is `Matrix<R, C>` (lesson 8.04).
`[[0.0; C]; R]` makes an empty result to fill in.
requirements: `struct Matrix<const R: usize, const C: usize>([[f64; C]; R])`.
`impl<const R: usize, const K: usize, const C: usize> Mul<Matrix<K, C>> for Matrix<R, K>` with `Output = Matrix<R, C>`.
`transpose`, `identity` for square sizes, `Index<(usize, usize)>`, and `Sum` for adding many matrices.
stretch: Add `determinant` for 2x2 and 3x3 matrices only, by implementing it on `Matrix<2, 2>` and `Matrix<3, 3>`.
